protocol.unselected_baseline: Original random founders reconstructed from the same training seed, before selection/mutation; starting physical hash checked against Step 16. No training or selection performed.
protocol.primary_family: 12 two-sided exact paired sign tests: four contrasts in each of three environments; Holm correction across all 12

primary_contrasts.evolved_bearing_benefit: (evolved intact minus mirrored meals) minus (unselected intact minus mirrored meals)
primary_contrasts.evolution_advantage: evolved intact minus unselected intact fitness
primary_contrasts.residual_advantage: evolved hidden minus unselected hidden fitness

protocol.analysis_unit: one source training lineage; test repeats averaged within environment before inference
protocol.decision: Higher/lower requires Holm p < 0.05 and mean-difference interval excluding zero in the same direction. Food-guidance attribution requires useful_bearing, evolved_bearing_benefit, and evolution_advantage all higher within an environment.
protocol.secondary: Other contrasts and steering/movement probes are descriptive, without confirmatory p-values.

diagnostic_probes.steering: 12 left/right target pairs per brain: +/-45 and +/-90 degrees, distances 40/80/120, hunger .25/.75, open walls; report gain and correct turn commands on both sides
diagnostic_probes.movement: No direct food inputs, open walls, hunger clamped at .25/.75; constant feed-forward turn response; analytic displacement/arc length after 12 seconds. Not a natural trajectory or planning test.

protocol.limitations: Mirroring changes bearing use; hidden food channels can cause input distribution shift and hunger retains indirect eating feedback. Residual benefits cannot establish an exclusive strategy. Founder comparison measures evolutionary history, without a neutral-mutation control. No planning or human-like intelligence claim.

evidence.interpretation_limit: Hidden inputs are a distribution shift; hunger retains indirect eating feedback. Residual benefit does not identify an exclusive movement strategy or exclude food-guided behavior.
